tool_input.command:
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec117/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && python3 -B plugins/dev-graph/scripts/resolve-repo-context.py --repo-root "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" --config "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.dev-graph/config.json" --mode write > "$TMPDIR/c24-rerun.json"; echo "exit=$?"; python3 -B -c '
import json,sys,os,hashlib
a=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));b=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
diff={k:(a.get(k),b.get(k)) for k in set(a)|set(b) if a.get(k)!=b.get(k)}
print("diff:",diff)
print("receipt sha256:",hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read()).hexdigest())
ss=a["content_roots"]["system_spec"]; root=a["repo_root"]
print("islink",os.path.islink(ss),"isdir",os.path.isdir(ss),"realpath",os.path.realpath(ss))
print("contained",os.path.commonpath([os.path.realpath(ss),os.path.realpath(root)])==os.path.realpath(root))
links=[]
for d,dn,fn in os.walk(ss):
  for n in dn+fn:
    p=os.path.join(d,n)
    if os.path.islink(p): links.append(p)
print("symlinks under system-spec:",links)
' eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-c24-receipt.json "$TMPDIR/c24-rerun.json"; git rev-parse --show-toplevel --git-common-dir --git-dir HEAD; git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir
